input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates. Customer shall give prompt written notice, and the assignee shall assume the applicable obligations.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position. § 24.1 lets us assign to an Affiliate or to a merger/acquisition/substantially-all-assets successor without Vendor's consent (notice only). § 24.2 bars Vendor from assigning, delegating material performance, or transferring by change of control without our prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and restricts assignment to a direct Customer competitor. § 24.3 makes other assignments consent-based on a not-unreasonably-withheld/conditioned/delayed standard. § 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control, and § 9 contains only an insolvency trigger, not a change-of-control trigger; § 13 (p0056) further confirms we may transfer licence rights on a permitted Section 24 assignment. The only wording short of preferred is that the competitor bar reads "direct Customer competitor without Customer's consent" rather than an absolute prohibition — a minor sub-element noted here rather than redlined, since the gate is our own consent and the clause otherwise sits above the fallback.
